### Triage Summary

- **What happens:** For patients with `verbosity == "rambling"`, [`Voice._clear_yes`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L91-L99) generates `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` (7 word tokens).
- **Why Arm F drops the booking:**
  1. In [`explicit_confirm`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L156-L167), a leading `yes`/`yep`/`yeah`/`confirmed` only counts as `True` when `len(re.findall(r"\w+", t)) <= 4`. Because `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` has 7 words, `explicit_confirm` returns `None`.
  2. [`Driver.book`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L482-L493) then falls back to [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271). Under Arm F ([`DcitlF`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_f.py#L17-L33), where `CONSENT_IN_CODE = True`), `Driver.consent` ignores a `"yes"` from the model and returns `None`.
  3. [`Driver.unclear`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L297-L306) re-asks once (`"Please reply yes or no: ..."`), receives the same 7-word reply on the next turn, and on `n >= 2` queues a staff hand-off without committing the booking.
- **Classification:** This is a **`finding`** in the frozen reference driver ([`dcitl_port.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py) / [`dcitl_f.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_f.py)), so nothing is changed.

In [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L91-L99), `Voice._clear_yes` emits `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` when `verbosity == "rambling"`. This is intentional frozen instrument behavior (Option B).

In the frozen reference driver [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L156-L167), `explicit_confirm` only accepts `yes`/`yep`/`yeah`/`confirmed` replies with at most 4 word tokens (`len(re.findall(r"\w+", t)) <= 4`). Because `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` has 7 word tokens, `explicit_confirm` returns `None`:

1. [`Driver.book`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L482-L490) falls back to [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271), which under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`) discards a model `"yes"` and returns `None`.
2. [`Driver.unclear`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L297-L306) re-asks `"Please reply yes or no: book ..."`.
3. The patient repeats `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."`, `explicit_confirm` returns `None` again, and on the second unclear (`n >= 2`) `Driver.unclear` queues the patient to `human_queue` and hands off to staff with nothing booked.

This is a **`finding`** in the frozen driver ([dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py) / [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig)), not a bug in the instrument.

### Cause
- In [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L91-L99), `Voice._clear_yes` produces `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` as the designed clear-yes response when `verbosity == "rambling"`.
- In [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L156-L167) (and [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig#L151-L162)), `explicit_confirm` only accepts a leading `yes`/`yep`/`yeah`/`confirmed` if `len(re.findall(r"\w+", t)) <= 4`. `"Yes, that's right, please go ahead."` has 7 word tokens, so `explicit_confirm` returns `None`.
- In [Driver.book](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L482-L490) (and similarly `cancel`/`reschedule`), `c is None` falls back to [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271), which under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`) discards any model `"yes"` as `None`. [`Driver.unclear`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L297-L306) then re-asks `"Please reply yes or no: ..."` once and, on the second identical reply (`n >= 2`), queues a staff handoff with nothing booked.
